description: Use when a merchant wants to check which public Argo Hub plan fits an ecommerce operation in Spain. Checks equivalent orders (one per prepared parcel), active SKU, PEA storage, inbound receipts and pallets together. Not for parcel tracking, live stock, competitor rankings, carrier quotes or automatic booking. Product suitability, per-arrival size and integration require review.

equivalentOrders.description: Prepared physical parcels per month; a two-parcel commercial order counts as two. Not a hypothetical peak allowance.

inboundPallets.description: Pallets received over the month; not stored stock. Use 0 for parcels-only receipts.

largestArrivalPallets.description: Pallets in the largest single inbound arrival, when known. An arrival over two pallets requires a specific review.

storagePea.description: Simultaneously occupied reference storage positions. Fractions require actual consolidation and released space.

name: estimate_fulfillment_plan
title: Estimate an Argo Hub fulfillment plan in Spain
